field_changes.label: Remark
field_changes.value_note: value is 'Late fee waived. ' repeated 3600 times (61,200 chars)

labels.rule: For each stored relation decision (left action, right action), label 'same' if both windows' documents map to the same task, else 'break'.

expected_rules_output.note: Produced by running the reference rules on these events with the format-bar lines removed (noise scoring not applied). A faithful rebuild must reach the same result with noise weighting applied to the format-bar lines.

sessions.switch: break 1.00 case_conflict hard (gap 2 s: interruption episode)
case_conflict; resumes suspended invoice episode (ticket span 13 s <= 120, returns to earlier case)
diversion 0.60 switch (signals recent, same_app; not hard)

journey_assertions: invoice approval is one task holding both invoice documents
ticket reply is its own task
personal browse is its own task, marked possibly personal (title names YouTube, no web address), not deleted until the employee says so
2 work tasks remain after 'This was personal'
object of invoice task = invoice; object of ticket task = ticket
task names match verb + object + system
no digit in a task name
expected_rules_output.scripted_label_counts: every stored relation decision between two windows is labelled same when THREE_TASK_OF agrees, else break; exact count not recorded in the source
